title: JustBans Redis envelope
description: The wrapper around every message on the justbans:events, justbans:commands and justbans:command-results channels. Every message on the wire carries `sig`. See docs/redis-protocol.md for how `sig` is computed.

v.description: Protocol version. Messages with any other value are dropped.

id.description: Message UUID, used for de-duplication. Events use a stable id derived from `seq`, so a re-published event has the same id.

type.description: Message type, e.g. PUNISHMENT_CREATED, ISSUE_PUNISHMENT, COMMAND_RESULT.

ts.description: Creation time in epoch milliseconds (UTC). Commands whose ts is more than max-skew-seconds (default 30) away from the plugin's clock are rejected with EXPIRED_REQUEST.

node.description: Id of the sending node: `node-id` of a plugin instance, or any stable name the web backend picks (e.g. web-1).

seq.description: Only on events: the jb_events.id of the event. A resume cursor for catching up from the database, not a gap-free counter. Absent on commands and results.

sig.description: Standard Base64 (with padding) of the 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 over v|id|type|ts|node|seq|canonical(payload).
